name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 17 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-09-04, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 1.61 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
